say:2:1321321001:1.text: M-Madam Gerda! These are the ingredients you ordered from Varon. Here's the inventory list, too!
say:2:1321321001:1.source_cn: 格、格尔达女士，这些是您从瓦迪姆老板那里订的食材。对了...

say:3:1321321002:1.text: Oh, Varon never disappoints! His team always brings the best.
say:3:1321321002:1.source_cn: 瓦迪姆手上的食材种类倒是很齐全，真不愧是雪松镇最靠谱的商人。

say:4:1321321003:1.text: But... hmm. These quantities don't quite match my order.
say:4:1321321003:1.source_cn: ……嗯？怎么有一些和我订的数量对不上？是我记错了吗？

say:5:1321321004:1.text: W-well... Varon's team searched the entire Duchy, but these were all they could procure for now. The rest either weren't fresh enough or were overpriced, and the boss didn't want to raise your costs...
say:5:1321321004:1.source_cn: 是……是这样的，瓦迪姆老板派人找遍了公国，但暂时只能采...

say:6:1321321005:1.text: But don't worry, he promised to send the rest in a few days!
say:6:1321321005:1.source_cn: 不过您放心，瓦迪姆老板过几天一定会补上这些缺口！这是他...

say:7:1321321006:1.text: I see... Well, it can't be helped. This will have to do for now. Thank you for bringing it.
say:7:1321321006:1.source_cn: 唉……这也不能怪你们，暂时这样吧。

say:10:1321321007:1.text: By the way, how is your fish experiment going? Did you find any fish that can adapt to the hot spring water?
say:10:1321321007:1.source_cn: 对了，格尔达女士，你的鱼怎么样了？有没有能适应温泉环境的？

say:11:1321321008:1.text: Ah, now there's both good news and bad news.
say:11:1321321008:1.source_cn: 亲爱的，在这方面有两个好消息，也有一个坏消息。

say:12:1321321009:1.text: One of the good news is two types of fish seem to thrive in the spring. The bad news... bubba shrimp, our most popular ingredient, doesn't make the cut.
say:12:1321321009:1.source_cn: 其中一个好消息是，有两种鱼能在温泉中存活。坏消息则是—...

choice_prompt:13:1321321009.text: One of the good news is two types of fish seem to thrive in the spring. The bad news... bubba shrimp, our most popular ingredient, doesn't make the cut.
choice_prompt:13:1321321009.source_cn: 其中一个好消息是，有两种鱼能在温泉中存活。坏消息则是——这两种鱼刚好是冰猫鱼和香脂鲱，作为食材最受欢迎的巴巴虾却没办法适应温泉。

say:14:1321321010:2.text: I remember bubba shrimp is one of Whiteridge's most famous delicacies. It's so tender and delicious, it's even good raw!
say:14:1321321010:2.source_cn: 我记得，巴巴虾是白山公国最出名的美食之一，味道鲜美，还...

say:15:1321321011:1.text: What?! Then does that mean Chippy can't eat any?!
say:15:1321321011:1.source_cn: ——什么？！那满满这次岂不是吃不到了？！

say:16:1321321012:1.text: Haha, don't worry too much, darling. There's more good news.
say:16:1321321012:1.source_cn: 别担心，亲爱的。还有另一个好消息呢。

say:17:1321321013:1.text: It turns out the hot spring water enhances the aroma of balm herring—it activates their glands, and the scent is just heavenly.
say:17:1321321013:1.source_cn: 我发现，温泉水可以激发香脂鲱的腺体，让它散发出更浓郁的香气。

say:18:1321321014:1.text: I've got a mind to create a brand-new dish with it. Something bold, something unique. Who knows? It might just become the Frozen Paw's signature dish.
say:18:1321321014:1.source_cn: 所以，我想试着用香脂鲱研发一道新菜，看看味道和卖相如何...

say:19:1321321015:1.text: Then Chippy wants to be the first to try it!
say:19:1321321015:1.source_cn: 那满满要做第一个尝试的客人！

say:21:1321321016:1.text: Have you decided on the recipe, Madam Gerda?
say:21:1321321016:1.source_cn: 格尔达女士，你已经想好菜谱了吗？

say:22:1321321017:1.text: I'm thinking I'll start with <style="highlight">snowgem juice</style> to cut the fishiness, then add a few aromatics to lift the flavor before simmering the herring to perfection.
say:22:1321321017:1.source_cn: 没有完全想好。总之要以香脂鲱为主，先用<style=h...

say:23:1321321018:1.text: But there's a problem—there aren't many suitable herbs available. So far, I can only think of <style="highlight">fortis herb</style>, but I need at least one more...
say:23:1321321018:1.source_cn: 不过，能激发香味的调料很少，我暂时只能想到<style...

say:24:1321321019:1.text: What about <style="highlight">misted beanberries</style>? We just gathered some.

say:25:1321321020:1.text: Oh, you're an angel! That's just what I needed. It wasn't on Varon's inventory list, so I thought I'd have to do without.
say:25:1321321020:1.source_cn: ——有粉面豆果就再好不过了！瓦迪姆给的货物清单上没有它...

say:26:1321321021:0.text: Looks like the recipe's complete now, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Let's give it a try!
